description: mod-values/*.json: the dossier's example and every field in clean files (good); what the schema refuses: experience without thresholds or with a scale, thresholds not from 0 or on another kind, a negative currency, a carried currency or untrusted carried value, readMods without allowList, a number format outside the list, numbers not in their string form, unknown keys and ids (schema); what kiln lint adds: the 64-bit range, min above max, initial outside them, thresholds that do not increase, a label over 1024 bytes, an id in two files, a carried value with no max (a warning) (rules)

diagnostics.message: value over: max "9223372036854775808" is outside the 64-bit range Kiln stores (-9223372036854775808 to 9223372036854775807)
value under: min "-9223372036854775809" is outside the 64-bit range Kiln stores (-9223372036854775808 to 9223372036854775807)
value upside: min "10" is above max "5": Kiln refuses the definition
value below-default: min "0" (the default) is above max "-1": Kiln refuses the definition
value init-high: initial "11" is outside min "0" (the default) and max "10": Kiln refuses the definition (it never clamps)
value steps: thresholds[2] "400" is not above thresholds[1] "900": thresholds strictly increase (Kiln refuses the definition)
value steps: thresholds[4] "1000" is not above thresholds[3] "1000": thresholds strictly increase (Kiln refuses the definition)
value long: label is 1102 bytes as compact JSON, and Kiln takes at most 1024 per definition (all its languages together)

value open-carried: a carried value without "max" can be raised as far as 9223372036854775807 by a player's own copy (Kiln keeps the higher of the world's value and the copy a client brings); give it a real max
value shared is also defined in mod-values/a.json: an id is defined once per mod, across all its mod-values files (Kiln refuses the second definition)
kind "experience" needs "thresholds" (the points each level starts at: "0", then strictly increasing)
an experience value counts whole points: "scale" is 0
the first threshold is "0" (level 1 starts at 0 points)
"thresholds" are for kind "experience" only
a currency or an experience value never goes below 0: "min" is "0" or more
"currency": only a counter or an experience value can be carried (a currency is never carried)
persistence "carried" needs "trustClientImports": true (a carried value comes from the player's client)

value carried-negative: a carried value without "max" can be raised as far as 9223372036854775807 by a player's own copy (Kiln keeps the higher of the world's value and the copy a client brings); give it a real max
a carried value never goes below 0: "min" is "0" or more
"readMods" is read with "readPolicy": "allowList" only: leave it empty, or use allowList
a number format: N0..N6, F0..F6, "0", or "0." followed by 1 to 6 zeros
a whole number as a base-10 string ("0", "250", "-12"): no '+', no leading zeros, no spaces, at most 19 digits
a whole number as a base-10 string ("0", "250", "-12"): no '+', no leading zeros, no spaces, at most 19 digits
a whole number as a base-10 string ("0", "250", "-12"): no '+', no leading zeros, no spaces, at most 19 digits
"intial" is not allowed here; did you mean "initial"?
"currncy" is not one of "counter", "currency", "experience"; did you mean "currency"?
missing "label"
key "Bad_Id": a value id: a lower-case letter, then up to 63 of a-z, 0-9, '.', '_' and '-'
